summary: Creates TOP feedback effects by sourcing its output stream from a downstream Target TOP when feedback is active, or passing through its input while reset/bypass is active. Use it with filter TOPs between the Feedback TOP and Target TOP for trails, echoes, fake motion blur, and recursive image processing.

key_params.name: top
key_params.note: Target TOP used as the feedback source when feedback is active.

key_params.name: reset
key_params.note: Disables feedback and passes through the input when set to 1; activates feedback when set to 0.

key_params.name: resetpulse
key_params.note: Resets feedback for a single frame.

key_params.name: outputresolution
key_params.note: Common TOP control for using, scaling, fitting, limiting, or overriding output resolution.

key_params.name: resolution
key_params.note: Custom output width and height when Output Resolution is Custom Resolution.

key_params.name: resmult
key_params.note: Apply the global TOP resolution multiplier.

key_params.name: outputaspect
key_params.note: Choose input, resolution-derived, or custom output aspect ratio.

key_params.name: inputfiltertype
key_params.note: Input image filtering: nearest, linear, or mipmap.

key_params.name: fillmode
key_params.note: Controls how the TOP image fills the node viewer.

key_params.name: npasses
key_params.note: Repeats the TOP operation multiple times.

key_params.name: chanmask
key_params.note: Choose which RGBA channels the TOP operates on.

key_params.name: format
key_params.note: Pixel format used to store image channel data.

key_concepts: filter TOPs between Feedback TOP and Target TOP
common_gotchas: Target TOP should point downstream in the feedback network; otherwise there is no closed feedback path for the accumulated image stream.
Reset disables feedback and passes through the connected input image, so a reset value of 1 is intentionally not a recursive feedback state.
Reset Pulse clears the feedback for a single frame; use it to initialize a loop without leaving reset held on.
Feedback loops usually need a Level TOP, Composite TOP, or other filter between the Feedback TOP and Target TOP to decay or transform the prior frame.
Use Info CHOP resx, resy, depth, and gpu_memory_used to confirm that a feedback loop is operating at the intended texture size and format.
